overall: AG found no violation. Five of six Finance Committee members signed a political ad backing the chair's Selectboard run, but the ad was not public business within the Committee's jurisdiction, so it was not a deliberation requiring an open meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a quorum of the Finance Committee deliberated outside a posted meeting to authorize, draft, and sign a political ad supporting the chair's Selectboard candidacy.
allegations.key_passage: we find this communication was not a deliberation that needed to occur during an open meeting because the advertisement was not "public business within [the Finance Committee's] jurisdiction."
